description:
## SOSA specification examples: Systems (Sensors, Actuators, Samplers)

Examples from the [SOSA/SSN specification](https://w3c.github.io/sdw-sosa-ssn/ssn/) whose root resource is validated against `ogc.sosa.properties.system`.

Each Turtle example is:

1. validated as RDF against the SHACL shapes inherited from `ogc.sosa.properties.system`;
2. converted by the `ttl-to-jsonld` transform: the root resource is framed and compacted with the `ogc.sosa.properties.system` JSON-LD context;
3. the transform output is validated against `ogc.sosa.properties.system` (output profile validation): JSON Schema, JSON-LD uplift with the target context, and SHACL.
